name: dart-tournament
description: LAN dart tournament software: host on a PC, score on phones

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.test:all: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
